Lemma
[Lower bound for $\mu $] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0027 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch17-logarithmic-sobolev 1. ch17:17.5\group Entropy Bounds

For every $\tau >0$, \[ \mu (g,\tau )\ge \tau R_{\min }(g)-2C(2\tau ,g) -\frac n2\log (4\pi \tau )-n. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma 2 with $a=2\tau $ to a normalized $w$. In the formula for $\mathcal K$, its gradient term cancels the resulting entropy estimate, and $\int Rw^2d\mu \ge R_{\min }(g)$. Take the infimum over $w$.

□
